content.title: Shark-to-Handbag Reversal | Threat Converted into Iridescent Product
content.summary: A mechanical bird becomes a chrome desk lamp after one induction pulse. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One readable threat and one adult responder share a continuous space before intervention. + A single committed counter-action visibly causes the conversion. + The source threat remains traceable through the intermediate material change. + The final product occupies the threat's registered impact position and is complete. + A terminal human reaction confirms the product state after an isolated hero hold.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult recycling engineer inside a dim steel sorting hall as a large rusted mechanical bird charges along one aisle. One cyan pulse hits the bird; keep its silhouette readable as plates fold inward along the same floor axis. Hold the lamp alone, then reconnect the engineer beside it with one restrained confirmation glance.
required_anchors: One readable threat and one adult responder share a continuous space before intervention.
A single committed counter-action visibly causes the conversion.
The final product occupies the threat's registered impact position and is complete.
A terminal human reaction confirms the product state after an isolated hero hold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A mechanical bird becomes a chrome desk lamp after one induction pulse. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

invariants.rule: One readable threat and one adult responder share a continuous space before intervention.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One readable threat and one adult responder share a continuous space before intervention."

invariants.rule: A single committed counter-action visibly causes the conversion.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A single committed counter-action visibly causes the conversion."

invariants.rule: The source threat remains traceable through the intermediate material change.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The source threat remains traceable through the intermediate material change."

invariants.rule: The final product occupies the threat's registered impact position and is complete.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The final product occupies the threat's registered impact position and is complete."

invariants.rule: A terminal human reaction confirms the product state after an isolated hero hold.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "A terminal human reaction confirms the product state after an isolated hero hold."
